Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Corp
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and build scalable services using Python, Go, and Kubernetes. Experience with AWS, PostgreSQL, and distributed systems is a strong plus. You will collaborate with product and design teams to ship features quickly while maintaining high reliability standards across our microservices architecture. This role requires strong communication skills and the ability to mentor junior engineers.
